scores.label: A
scores.note: hollow and desolate fit well; meaningless and vacant are acceptable but slightly odd for a feeling. 3 pointless and 10 futile describe actions, not how a person feels. 5 devoid is ungrammatical without 'of'. 6 worthless shifts to self-worth. 7 void and 9 barren are odd/unidiomatic for a feeling.
